title: Illustration with Description and Caption

illustrates.quote: Some images may require a description, which is enclosed in transcriber’s note indicators following the caption. Use appropriate vocabulary for the grade level and subject matter.

figure.description: A referee is separating two athletes who are arguing and pointing fingers at each other.

blocks.description: A referee is separating two athletes who are arguing and pointing fingers at each other.

blocks.text: **Views of anger** How would each of psychology's levels of analysis explain what's going on here?
blocks.features: 'Views of anger' is bold; the rest of the caption is plain.
Vertical photo-credit text running down the image's left edge.

print.notes: The transcriber added a description of the photograph in a transcriber's note after the caption; here (unlike example-6-1/6-2) print.blocks[0].description IS built — it matches the second agreed transcriber's-note block word for word. The photo credit (second caption block) is ignored in the braille (BANA gives no source-citation mechanism Emboss implements; see F-168) and is not built.
print.printFeatures: A photograph with a caption below it. A vertical photo credit is on the left side of the image.

braille.notes: A transcriber's note '[photograph]' is added before the caption (print does not identify the illustration, 6.2.2b). 'Views of anger' is bold in print, wrapped in UEB bold passage indicators '^7'/'^''. The description of the photo is enclosed in transcriber's note indicators and placed after the caption (6.3.1), with no blank line before or after (6.2.2a).

resolution: A and B agreed byte-for-byte, but both shared the same omission: neither recorded that 'Views of anger' is bold (not plain). Confirmed two ways: (1) direct inspection of the PDF page image (p.148, printed 6-4) shows it visibly bolder than the rest of the caption; (2) forward-translation proof — marking the first 14 characters TF_BOLD reproduces the agreed braille exactly ('^7,views ( ang]^''...), while marking the same span TF_ITALIC instead produces '.1,views...' (wrong) — confirming bold, not italic. This is exactly the 'agreement is no evidence' risk the task instructions warn about: a shared model error that comparing the two runs against each other could never have surfaced. Correction: **bold** cell-markup added to the caption text, with a features field recording it. Also confirmed here (unlike example-6-1/6-2): figure.description IS separately rendered — forward-translating it alone reproduces the second agreed transcriber's-note block exactly, so it is consumed by buildModel6 for this file. The photo-credit caption is recorded as a limitation per F-168 (source citations/credits inside an imggroup are lost by Emboss).
